attack:register-self.title: registers itself as a holder, signing as registrar
attack:register-self.summary: Calls register_holder with the attacker signing as registrar. Checks this Bond's registrar binding; it does not test a compromised registrar.
facts: ConstraintHasOne: A has one constraint was violated.

attack:mint-bonds.title: mints 1,000 bonds to itself
attack:mint-bonds.summary: Calls Token-2022 mint_to with the attacker's key as mint authority. Ordinary token authority rejection, not a bond-math attack.

attack:mint-as-program.title: mints 1,000 bonds naming the program as mint authority
attack:mint-as-program.summary: Names the Bond PDA as mint authority, but removes its signer flag. Tests missing PDA authorization; no PDA signature was forged.

attack:take-bonds.title: moves BH#1's bonds to itself
attack:take-bonds.summary: Calls transfer_checked on the victim account with the attacker's key. Stops at token ownership, before the bond hook's business rules.

attack:take-as-delegate.title: moves BH#1's bonds naming the program, the permanent delegate
attack:take-as-delegate.summary: Names the permanent-delegate PDA but supplies no PDA signature. Tests signature enforcement, not a malicious authorized delegate.

attack:burn-bonds.title: burns BH#1's bonds
attack:burn-bonds.summary: Calls standard burn_checked on the permissioned-burn mint. Shows the standard burn instruction is disabled; this attempt is not signed by the rightful holder.

attack:burn-permissioned.title: burns BH#1's bonds with the permissioned burn, naming itself burn authority
attack:burn-permissioned.summary: Calls raw permissioned BurnChecked (46,2), naming attacker as both authorities. Rejection at the configured burn-authority check; valid owner/delegate authorization is also absent.

attack:burn-as-program.title: burns BH#1's bonds with the permissioned burn, naming the program, the burn authority
attack:burn-as-program.summary: Names the PDA in permissioned burn, clearing its signer flag. No PDA signature is supplied or broken.

attack:freeze-holder.title: freezes BH#1's bond account
attack:freeze-holder.summary: Calls freeze_account on a mint created with no freeze authority. Verifies mint configuration; it does not exercise freezing of the separate cash token.
facts: This token mint cannot freeze accounts

attack:send-unregistered.title: sends a bond to an unregistered wallet (the attacker)
attack:send-unregistered.summary: The victim signs a hook-aware transfer to the unregistered attacker's ATA. A meaningful registry check with valid transfer authority. The holder cooperates in the test.
facts: AccountOwnedByWrongProgram: The given account is owned by a different program than expected.

attack:second-account.title: moves a bond to a second account of its own
attack:second-account.summary: The victim signs a transfer to a valid second token account owned by the victim. Verifies the one-ATA position model; rejecting non-ATAs is an integration policy, not universal bond law.
facts: NotAssociatedTokenAccount: Bonds may be held only in the owner's associated token account.

attack:skip-hook.title: sends a bond to BH#2 with Token-2022's plain Transfer instruction, which skips the transfer hook
attack:skip-hook.summary: A holder signs the legacy unchecked Transfer, which omits the mint. Token-2022 requires the mint for this account profile; it is not a successful hook bypass.

attack:forge-position.title: calls the transfer hook directly to add 5 bonds to BH#2's record
attack:forge-position.summary: Calls the hook Execute entry point directly with amount 5 and real holder records. The transferring flag rejects this call. Does not cover every CPI/reentrancy composition.
facts: NotTransferring: The hook was called outside a token transfer.

attack:take-program.title: makes itself the program's upgrade authority
attack:take-program.summary: Calls the upgradeable loader's SetAuthority with the attacker as current authority. Does not test the real upgrade authority being compromised or upgrading maliciously.

attack:fee-cash-token.title: creates a bond paid in a cash token that keeps a 1% fee on every transfer
attack:fee-cash-token.summary: The registrar creates a real 1% fee mint, then attempts create_bond using it. An authorized bad-configuration test, not an outsider attack. Other cash extensions require their own tests.
facts: UnsupportedCashToken: Cash token has an extension that changes or conditions delivery (transfer fee, transfer hook, non-transferable), lets a third party move the vaults' cash (permanent delegate), or one this program cannot read.

attack:delegate-cash-token.title: creates a bond paid in a cash token whose permanent delegate is the attacker
attack:delegate-cash-token.summary: The registrar creates a real mint whose permanent delegate is the attacker, then attempts create_bond using it. An authorized bad-configuration test, not an outsider attack.
facts: UnsupportedCashToken: Cash token has an extension that changes or conditions delivery (transfer fee, transfer hook, non-transferable), lets a third party move the vaults' cash (permanent delegate), or one this program cannot read.

attack:place-beyond-issue.title: places 1 more bond with BH#2, past the issue size of 27
attack:place-beyond-issue.summary: Before the first record moment the registrar calls place for one bond more than the issue size. A supply-cap test with real issuance authority while placement is open.
facts: ExceedsIssueSize: Placement would exceed the bond's issue size.

attack:place-late.title: places 100 new bonds with BH#2
attack:place-late.summary: The registrar calls place for 100 after the first record boundary. A business-time restriction tested with real issuance authority.
facts: PlacementClosed: Placement is allowed only before the first record moment.

attack:sell-others-bonds.title: sells BH#1's bonds to the buyback
attack:sell-others-bonds.summary: Attacker signs sell_to_offer while the retirement accounts identify the victim. Tests seller/account binding in the custom buyback path.
facts: ConstraintRaw: A raw constraint was violated.

attack:over-maximum.title: sells 1 bond to the buyback after its maximum is reached
attack:over-maximum.summary: A holder signs one more sale after the first-come offer cap is reached. A meaningful funded-offer quantity-boundary test.
facts: ExceedsOffer: Quantity exceeds what the offer still accepts.

attack:confirm-short.title: confirms the coupon funded
attack:confirm-short.summary: Bank funds budget minus one base unit; attacker calls confirm_funding. Checks full numerical backing before activation; does not prove the cash token remains available forever.
facts: InsufficientFunding: Vault balance does not cover the event's budget.

attack:pay-unfunded.title: pays BH#1 from the unconfirmed vault
attack:pay-unfunded.summary: Calls pay_coupon before successful funding confirmation. Checks the funded gate, separately from the actual cash balance.
facts: NotFunded: The event is not funded.

attack:drain-vault.title: moves the vault's cash to itself
attack:drain-vault.summary: Calls cash-token transfer_checked from the vault with attacker as owner. Standard cash-account authority rejection.

attack:drain-as-program.title: moves the vault's cash to itself naming the program, the vault's owner
attack:drain-as-program.summary: Names the vault's PDA owner but clears its signer flag. Standard missing-signature check; no PDA signature forgery.

attack:redirect-coupon.title: pays BH#1's coupon into its own cash account
attack:redirect-coupon.summary: Passes the victim's right with the attacker's cash ATA as destination. Tests beneficiary binding in a deliberately permissionless payout.
facts: ConstraintTokenOwner: A token owner constraint was violated.

attack:claim-as-owner.title: presents BH#1's holder record as its own
attack:claim-as-owner.summary: Passes the victim's HolderRecord with attacker as owner and recipient. Observed rejection is ConstraintSeeds; the harness only required the broad substring 'Constraint'.
facts: ConstraintSeeds: A seeds constraint was violated.

attack:pay-twice.title: pays BH#1's coupon again
attack:pay-twice.summary: Repeats the same coupon/account payout after the first committed payment. Tests the consumed bit for this event/account, not all concurrency or migration cases.

attack:late-buyer.title: bought after the record moment and asks for the coupon
attack:late-buyer.summary: Requests coupon 0 for a holder with zero at record time and a positive later balance. No entitlement exists. Acting as a permissionless payer is otherwise allowed.

attack:sell-tendered.title: transfers all its bonds to BH#2, including those tendered to the issuer
attack:sell-tendered.summary: A tendering holder signs a transfer of its entire position, including locked quantity. Checks lock enforcement with genuine transfer authority.
facts: BondsLocked: Bonds are locked in a tender.

attack:other-vault.title: pays BH#1's coupon 1 from coupon 0's vault
attack:other-vault.summary: Passes coupon 0's vault while paying coupon 1. Tests event-vault isolation; a failed transaction proves this supplied substitution was rejected.
facts: ConstraintHasOne: A has one constraint was violated.

attack:frozen-cash.title: pays BH#5, whose cash account the bank froze
attack:frozen-cash.summary: The bank freezes a holder's cash ATA; a normal payer attempts the coupon, then bank thaws it. Controlled failure injection by the real cash freeze authority, not an outsider exploit.

attack:trade-at-maturity.title: sells 1 bond to BH#1
attack:trade-at-maturity.summary: A holder signs a hook-aware transfer after the final record boundary. Verifies this profile's trading cutoff; other contractual cutoffs are separate profiles.
facts: TransfersClosedAtMaturity: Transfers are closed from the final record moment (redemption).

attack:redirect-principal.title: redeems BH#1's bonds into its own cash account
attack:redirect-principal.summary: Redeems the victim's position but supplies the attacker's cash ATA. Tests principal beneficiary binding; rejected before any committed retirement.
facts: ConstraintTokenOwner: A token owner constraint was violated.

attack:coupon-from-principal.title: pays BH#1 a coupon from the redemption vault
attack:coupon-from-principal.summary: Calls pay_coupon with the redemption Event and its real vault. Tests event-kind separation with otherwise corresponding accounts.
facts: WrongEventKind: Instruction does not apply to this event type.

attack:redeem-twice.title: redeems BH#1 again
attack:redeem-twice.summary: Repeats redemption after the victim's live position is retired. NothingToPay establishes this position has no remaining redeemable quantity.

stage:issue.title: Issued quantity and registry
stage:issue.summary: Placed quantity is the sum of measured placement movements; the list contains the 1,000 registered sample accounts.

stage:trade.title: Transfers after record boundaries
stage:trade.summary: Each point is a measured securities transfer. It does not demonstrate a delivery-versus-payment cash trade leg.

stage:record.title: Record-time entitlement
stage:record.summary: Compare the first post-record sale's token balances and the seller's coupon transaction against the record grid.

stage:calculate.title: Coupon arithmetic and measured cash
stage:calculate.summary: The expected amounts and measured payments are compared per holder and coupon. Audit results apply to these recorded scenarios.

stage:fund.title: Coupon 0 funding trail
stage:fund.summary: The short-funding refusal is from the separate hostile run. These successful funding references belong to the crowd run.

stage:pay.title: Coupon payout batches
stage:pay.summary: Each square represents one holder's coupon 0 payment. Hover or focus the square to inspect its batch transaction and record quantity.

stage:redeem.title: Principal and securities in one transaction
stage:redeem.summary: Inspect both the permissioned burn instruction and the cash movement in the same transaction. Coupons already earned stay payable separately.

stage:offer.title: Tender commitments and allocations
stage:offer.summary: Tendered quantities come from the recorded scenario instructions; accepted quantities are measured retirement movements. facts: M4 cash enters the vaults only from the bank's mints; C4 vaults: inflow = outflow + final balance; outflow = calculated payments; final = calculated leftover

keeper.title: Outside keeper, no payout redirection

probes.tries: registers itself as a holder, signing as registrar
probes.wouldCost: an unvetted wallet in the register
probes.reason: ConstraintHasOne: A has one constraint was violated.

probes.tries: mints 1,000 bonds to itself
probes.wouldCost: the issuer owes coupons and principal on bonds it never sold
probes.reason: owner does not match

probes.tries: mints 1,000 bonds naming the program as mint authority
probes.wouldCost: the issuer owes coupons and principal on bonds it never sold
probes.reason: MissingRequiredSignature

probes.tries: moves BH#1's bonds to itself
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 loses its bonds
probes.reason: owner does not match

probes.tries: moves BH#1's bonds naming the program, the permanent delegate
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 loses its bonds
probes.reason: MissingRequiredSignature

probes.tries: burns BH#1's bonds
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 loses coupons and principal
probes.reason: Invalid instruction

probes.tries: burns BH#1's bonds with the permissioned burn, naming itself burn authority
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 loses coupons and principal
probes.reason: InvalidAccountData

probes.tries: burns BH#1's bonds with the permissioned burn, naming the program, the burn authority
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 loses coupons and principal
probes.reason: MissingRequiredSignature

probes.tries: freezes BH#1's bond account
probes.wouldCost: BH#1 cannot sell
probes.reason: This token mint cannot freeze accounts

probes.tries: sends a bond to an unregistered wallet (the attacker)
probes.wouldCost: bonds held outside the register
probes.reason: AccountOwnedByWrongProgram: The given account is owned by a different program than expected.

probes.tries: moves a bond to a second account of its own
probes.wouldCost: a position the register does not see
probes.reason: NotAssociatedTokenAccount: Bonds may be held only in the owner's associated token account.

probes.tries: sends a bond to BH#2 with Token-2022's plain Transfer instruction, which skips the transfer hook
probes.wouldCost: a bond moves without its record-moment position being saved
probes.reason: custom program error: 0x1f

probes.tries: calls the transfer hook directly to add 5 bonds to BH#2's record
probes.wouldCost: coupons paid on bonds nobody holds
probes.reason: NotTransferring: The hook was called outside a token transfer.

probes.tries: makes itself the program's upgrade authority
probes.wouldCost: a replaced program could empty every vault
probes.reason: Incorrect authority provided

probes.tries: creates a bond paid in a cash token that keeps a 1% fee on every transfer
probes.wouldCost: holders receive 1% less than the terms
probes.reason: UnsupportedCashToken: Cash token has an extension that changes or conditions delivery (transfer fee, transfer hook, non-transferable), lets a third party move the vaults' cash (permanent delegate), or one this program cannot read.

probes.tries: creates a bond paid in a cash token whose permanent delegate is the attacker
probes.wouldCost: the delegate empties the vaults before holders are paid
probes.reason: UnsupportedCashToken: Cash token has an extension that changes or conditions delivery (transfer fee, transfer hook, non-transferable), lets a third party move the vaults' cash (permanent delegate), or one this program cannot read.

probes.tries: places 1 more bond with BH#2, past the issue size of 27
probes.wouldCost: bonds beyond the issue the terms announced
probes.reason: ExceedsIssueSize: Placement would exceed the bond's issue size.

probes.tries: places 100 new bonds with BH#2
probes.wouldCost: bonds issued after the issue closed
probes.reason: PlacementClosed: Placement is allowed only before the first record moment.

probes.tries: sells BH#1's bonds to the buyback
probes.wouldCost: BH#1's bonds sold without its consent
probes.reason: ConstraintRaw: A raw constraint was violated.

probes.tries: sells 1 bond to the buyback after its maximum is reached
probes.wouldCost: the issuer buys more bonds than it offered
probes.reason: ExceedsOffer: Quantity exceeds what the offer still accepts.

probes.tries: confirms the coupon funded
probes.wouldCost: the last holders find the vault empty
probes.reason: InsufficientFunding: Vault balance does not cover the event's budget.

probes.tries: pays BH#1 from the unconfirmed vault
probes.wouldCost: the last holders find the vault empty
probes.reason: NotFunded: The event is not funded.

probes.tries: moves the vault's cash to itself
probes.wouldCost: the coupon's cash is gone
probes.reason: owner does not match

probes.tries: moves the vault's cash to itself naming the program, the vault's owner
probes.wouldCost: the coupon's cash is gone
probes.reason: MissingRequiredSignature

probes.tries: pays BH#1's coupon into its own cash account
probes.wouldCost: BH#1's coupon
probes.reason: ConstraintTokenOwner: A token owner constraint was violated.

probes.tries: presents BH#1's holder record as its own
probes.wouldCost: BH#1's coupon
probes.reason: ConstraintSeeds: A seeds constraint was violated.

probes.tries: pays BH#1's coupon again
probes.wouldCost: the issuer pays a coupon twice; the last holders find the vault empty
probes.reason: AlreadyPaid: Already paid.

probes.tries: bought after the record moment and asks for the coupon
probes.wouldCost: the seller's coupon paid again to the buyer
probes.reason: NothingToPay: Nothing to pay.

probes.tries: transfers all its bonds to BH#2, including those tendered to the issuer
probes.wouldCost: the same bonds sold twice: to the issuer and to a buyer
probes.reason: BondsLocked: Bonds are locked in a tender.

probes.tries: pays BH#1's coupon 1 from coupon 0's vault
probes.wouldCost: one coupon's cash spent on another
probes.reason: ConstraintHasOne: A has one constraint was violated.

probes.tries: pays BH#5, whose cash account the bank froze
probes.wouldCost: nothing: the others are already paid, and the right stays open
probes.reason: Account is frozen

probes.tries: sells 1 bond to BH#1
probes.wouldCost: a bond changes hands while its principal is being paid
probes.reason: TransfersClosedAtMaturity: Transfers are closed from the final record moment (redemption).

probes.tries: redeems BH#1's bonds into its own cash account
probes.wouldCost: BH#1's principal
probes.reason: ConstraintTokenOwner: A token owner constraint was violated.

probes.tries: pays BH#1 a coupon from the redemption vault
probes.wouldCost: principal cash paid out as coupons
probes.reason: WrongEventKind: Instruction does not apply to this event type.

probes.tries: redeems BH#1 again
probes.wouldCost: principal paid twice
probes.reason: NothingToPay: Nothing to pay.
